roles.NAUO1: L1 - car deck (datum); top face +Y; flat slotted end = front (+X)
roles.NAUO2: L2 - keel/rear skid under the deck; hook at the front over L1, tabs up through L1; battery seat; notches for L3 (bottom), L4/L5 (top)
roles.NAUO3: L3 - U-shaped battery cradle / second skid under the rear; two split snap tabs up through L1
roles.NAUO4: L4 - rear cross-member of the motor bay; servo ear holes, servo lead holes, closed slots for L6/L7 snap tabs, grooves for the shield board
roles.NAUO5: L5 - front cross-member of the motor bay; servo ear holes, closed slots L6/L7 pass through, grooves for the shield board
roles.NAUO6: L6 - right (+Z) front clip: slides -X through L5 into L4 (split snap tab), clamps L1 edge, head stops shield (+X)
roles.NAUO7: L7 - left (-Z) front clip, as L6
roles.NAUO8: right wheel (Pololu 60 x 8 mm: rim + tyre), pressed on NAUO17 spline
roles.NAUO9: left wheel, same part as NAUO8 flipped to face -Z and spun 22.5 deg about the axle (the 78.4 mm box in cad_tree.md is the box of that turned box)
roles.NAUO10: car radio nRF24L01, plugged into the adapter U3, antenna end toward the front (+X)
roles.NAUO11: controller radio nRF24L01, plugged into controller 2x4 socket (NAUO44), lying flat toward +X
roles.NAUO12: controller left joystick KY-023 (L-JS), PCB in the board cut-out, 5-pin right-angle header into NAUO49
roles.NAUO13: controller right joystick KY-023 (R-JS), same part translated +72.77 Z, into NAUO48
roles.NAUO14: 9 V battery, standing (47.9 tall) through L1 rectangular hole, in L3 cradle, on L2 notch floor y 892.2
roles.NAUO15: 9 V battery snap ("DC_Adaptor") on the battery terminals
roles.NAUO16: Mini-B USB plug (54 mm incl. cable stub) in the controller Nano; no A end
roles.NAUO17: right wheel servo FS90R (+Z side), shaft +Z; lead exits its -X face near the bottom
roles.NAUO18: left wheel servo FS90R (-Z side), NAUO17 turned 180 deg about X
roles.NAUO19: right servo plug housing (3-way), PLUGGED on U2 (RWh); pose 2
roles.NAUO20: left servo plug housing, PLUGGED on U1 (LWh); pose 2
roles.NAUO21: right servo plug housing, LOOSE end of the straight lead; pose 1
roles.NAUO22: left servo plug housing, LOOSE; pose 1
roles.NAUO23: car Nano I/O shield (same CAD part as the MRA I/O module) with the car Nano inside it as node NAUO86
roles.NAUO24: controller guard, left half (one printed body in the CAD)
roles.NAUO26: L-shaped TechBox adapter board: U1/U2 3-pin male on top, U3 2x4 socket on top, C1; female headers underneath onto the shield
roles.NAUO27: controller Arduino Nano (one mesh), in H2/H1
roles.NAUO28: barrel plug of the battery lead, UNPLUGGED pose (8.95 mm back from NAUO29); pairs with lead NAUO42
roles.NAUO29: barrel plug, PLUGGED pose (7.0 mm into the shield jack); pairs with lead NAUO41
roles.NAUO30: controller PCB ("Nano Board Controller") with H1/H2 15-pin sockets, L-JS/R-JS 2x5 right-angle sockets, 2x4 radio socket, C1
roles.NAUO31: right servo lead, pose 1 (loose, straight, flat 3-wire ribbon 56.5 mm)
roles.NAUO32: right servo lead pose 1: separated yellow end (14.4 mm)
roles.NAUO39: right servo lead, pose 2 (routed up in a loop to U2, ~165 mm)
roles.NAUO40: left servo lead, pose 2 (routed to U1, ~110 mm)
roles.NAUO41: battery lead (red/black, snap to barrel plug), PLUGGED pose (with NAUO29)
